title: LFM2.5-VL-3B：面向边缘场景的更优、更快的视觉语言模型
summary: Liquid AI 发布了 LFM2.5-VL-3B，这是一个专为边缘设备设计的 3B 参数视觉语言模型，旨在实现更优的视觉能力和更快的推理速度。该模型基于混合架构（可能结合了状态空间模型和注意力机制），在保持低计算开销的同时，显著提升了图像理解、视觉问答和文档理解等任务的性能。与同尺寸模型（如 Phi-3.5-vision、Qwen2-VL-2B 等）相比，LFM2.5-VL-3B 在多个基准测试中表现出更高的准确率，并具有更低的延迟和内存占用，适合在手机、嵌入式设备等资源受限环境中部署。模型支持多模态输入，包括图像和文本，能够处理高分辨率图像，并采用高效的 token 化策略减少计算量。Liquid AI 还提供了模型权重和推理代码，便于开发者集成。该模型体现了边缘 AI 领域对高效多模态模型的需求，有望推动视觉应用在边缘端的普及。
summary_en: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-VL-3B, a 3B-parameter vision-language model designed for edge devices, aiming to achieve better vision capabilities and faster inference. The model leverages a hybrid architecture (possibly combining state-space models and attention) to improve performance on tasks like image understanding, visual question answering, and document understanding while maintaining low computational overhead. Compared to same-size models (e.g., Phi-3.5-vision, Qwen2-VL-2B), LFM2.5-VL-3B demonstrates higher accuracy on several benchmarks, with lower latency and memory footprint, making it suitable for deployment in resource-constrained environments such as phones and embedded devices. The model supports multimodal inputs (image and text), handles high-resolution images, and uses efficient tokenization to reduce computation. Liquid AI provides model weights and inference code for easy integration. This release highlights the growing demand for efficient multimodal models in edge AI, potentially accelerating edge-side vision applications.
